C0157.title: Programmer Yang Lin Sentenced for Developing Red Packet Snatching Cracked App
keywords: providing programs for intruding into computer information systems
C0157.summary: Programmer Yang Lin developed a cracked app with features like instant grabbing and mine avoidance for red packet grabbing, and sold activation codes for profit, illegally earning over 100,000 yuan.
